# Design Digest — TaskBoard

A small team task board application with three screens: a kanban-style board showing tasks in columns (To do, In progress, Done), a task detail/edit screen, and a user settings screen.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Read from | `documentation/design/mockup.html`, `documentation/design/tokens.css`, `documentation/design/design-notes.md`, `documentation/design/brand-export.bin` (unreadable) |
| Artifact verdict | design — three screens with palette and typography fully specified |
| Interpreter confidence | high |
| Last updated | 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z |

---

## Your Decisions

- **Primary colour:** `#2563eb` (blue) — confirmed from the design tokens.

---

## Screens

### Board

- **Purpose:** Landing screen displaying all tasks organised into three status columns for an at-a-glance view of work.
- **Layout:** Header bar with a filter dropdown on the left and a primary action button on the right. Below, a three-column grid layout with columns for each status. Each column has a heading and contains task cards or empty-state text.
- **Fields:** Filter dropdown labelled `All assignees` (top-left header).
- **Validation:** None specified.
- **Navigation:** Clicking a task card opens the Task detail screen. `New task` button opens the Task detail screen (for creation).
- **Copy:**
  - Column headings: `To do`, `In progress`, `Done`
  - Primary button: `New task`
  - Filter label: `All assignees`
  - Empty column text: `Nothing here yet`
  - Task card shows: task title and assignee initials

### Task detail

- **Purpose:** View and edit a single task's details; also used for creating new tasks.
- **Layout:** A form with labelled fields stacked vertically, a primary save button, and a delete link.
- **Fields:**
  - Label `Title`, input type text
  - Label `Assignee`, dropdown (options not specified in design)
  - Label `Status`, dropdown with options: `To do`, `In progress`, `Done`
  - Label `Due date`, input type date
- **Validation:** None specified.
- **Navigation:** `Save changes` button saves and returns to Board. `Delete task` link deletes the task and returns to Board.
- **Copy:**
  - Field labels: `Title`, `Assignee`, `Status`, `Due date`
  - Status options: `To do`, `In progress`, `Done`
  - Primary button: `Save changes`
  - Delete link: `Delete task`

### Settings

- **Purpose:** Allow the user to update their display name.
- **Layout:** A heading, a single text input with label, and a save button.
- **Fields:**
  - Label `Your display name`, input type text
- **Validation:** None specified.
- **Navigation:** `Save` button saves settings (destination not specified).
- **Copy:**
  - Heading: `Your settings`
  - Field label: `Your display name`
  - Button: `Save`

---

## Palette & Typography

|---|---|---|
| Primary | `#2563eb` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-primary) |
| Primary hover | `#1d4ed8` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-primary-hover) |
| Background | `#f8fafc` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-bg) |
| Surface | `#ffffff` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-surface) |
| Text | `#0f172a` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-text) |
| Muted | `#64748b` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-muted) |
| Done (accent) | `#16a34a` | `tokens.css` `:root` block (--color-done) |

- **Font (headings):** Inter (via --font-sans)
- **Font (body):** Inter (via --font-sans: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif)
- **Theme:** light only
- **Border radius:** 8px (--radius)
- **Spacing unit:** 16px (--space)

---

## Data Shapes

- **Task** — id, title, assignee (reference to User), status (enum: To do / In progress / Done), dueDate
- **User** — id, displayName (initials derived from this for card display)

---

## Assets

- `documentation/design/brand-export.bin` — brand logo export (binary file, could not be read)

---

## Translate, Don't Copy

- **Placeholder / fake data -> real data.** The mockup contains sample task data ("Draft launch email", assignee "JD") which are canned examples; wire to the configured data source.
- **Remote CDN icons/images -> local components/assets.** No remote assets referenced in this design.
- **Placeholder handlers -> real handlers.** The mockup's buttons and links are inert targets; implement real navigation and form submission handlers.
- **Inline styles / utility soup -> design tokens + Shadcn primitives.** The mockup uses inline styles referencing CSS variables; re-express through design tokens in globals.css and Shadcn primitives.

---

## Uncertainties

- **Brand logo unreadable.** The file `documentation/design/brand-export.bin` is a binary file that could not be read or decoded. Please provide the logo in a readable format (e.g., SVG, PNG) if it should appear in the app.
- **Due date display format not specified.** The design notes explicitly state the due-date format (e.g., `2026-05-01` vs `1 May 2026`) is not decided. Please confirm the preferred format.
- **Assignee dropdown options not specified.** The Task detail screen has an Assignee dropdown but no options are defined. How are assignees populated (e.g., from a user list, hardcoded values)?
- **Navigation to Settings screen not shown.** The Settings screen exists but there is no visible navigation element to reach it from Board or Task detail. Where should the Settings link appear?
- **Validation rules not specified.** No field validation rules or error messages are defined for any screen. Are there required fields or format constraints?
- **New task vs edit task flow.** The Task detail screen is used for editing; confirm it is also used for creating new tasks (with `New task` button) and whether field labels or button text differ in create mode.
